Subject: Redwood intake — FedRAMP scoping workshop & SIG/CAIQ follow-ups

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We’re the independent assessment firm supporting the FedRAMP pre-scope and ISO overlap analysis for CedarBank. Before we schedule the scoping workshop, we need two quick confirmations so we can size the engagement:

1) Will Redwood be treating Dedicated capacity (the "Dedicated" product) as in-scope for the federal connector, or will only Hosted API + Private (VPC) be considered? That changes control mapping and sampling strategies.

2) For artifact delivery, do you prefer a single archived package (PDFs + console exports) or staged delivery via a secure SFTP with per-policy folders? If SFTP, please provide an owner and expected windows.

Attached is our updated intake_form_v2.pdf with the initial list of evidence requests (SOC2/GDPR/CAIQ/SIG fields). A couple of items we flagged as likely follow-ups: KMS rotation logs, HSM attestations, and a short-lived key-handling policy for on-prem connectors.

Can you confirm scope by end of day Thursday so we can place resources? Also, we propose a 60-minute scoping call on 2027-03-04 — please indicate availability.

Best,
Leah Martin
Lead Assessor
ComplianceTech

Olga / Mina — quick technical clarifications and what I can own: 

- Dedicated in-scope? Yes, we can treat Dedicated as in-scope conditionally. Important caveat: Dedicated customers can opt for customer-managed keys in their VPC; for FedRAMP scoping we only need samples where Redwood-managed KMS is used. If CedarBank requires Dedicated with Redwood-managed keys, we’ll include that pool in sampling.

- HSM attestation: We use a third-party HSM provider (HSMCo) for key wrapping. I can pull the HSM attestation PDF and the KMS rotation ledger exports (console CSV + signed system logs) by 2027-03-05.

- Key rotation logs location: rotation events are in our internal KMS audit table and also streamed to the secure audit S3 bucket (encrypted) — we can provide a time-bounded CSV export. Confirm whether the auditor requires cryptographic signatures on the logs or an auditor attestation is sufficient.

- Retention windows: we keep full runtime logs for 90 days and config snapshots for 365 days; archived logs beyond that require an IR ticket. For FedRAMP, we should state the 365-day availability for control sampling.

I will prepare: 
A) KMS rotation CSV + brief readme describing fields;
B) HSM attestation + vendor contact;
C) diagram of key custody flows (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed).

I can have A/B/C in the SFTP staging area by 2027-03-05.

Karthik
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Subject: Redwood — proposed FedRAMP/ISO scope & artifact delivery plan

Hi Leah / CedarBank procurement team,

Thanks for the intake. After an internal triage, here is our proposed approach so you can confirm and we can lock a scoping call: 

Proposed scope
- In-scope: Hosted API (public) and Private (VPC) with Redwood-managed KMS.
- Conditional in-scope: Dedicated capacity when Redwood-managed keys are used (we will provide a clear list of Dedicated pools during the scoping call).

Artifact delivery
- Preferred: staged delivery via secure SFTP (we will create per-control folders).
- Staging cadence: weekly snapshots starting 2027-03-05, final packaged delivery by 2027-03-10.

Requested confirmations from your side
1) Accept staged SFTP as the initial delivery mechanism (we’ll share credentials and a folder template).
2) Confirm your evidence sampling window (we propose: last 90 days for operational logs, 365 days for config/attestation artifacts).
3) Indicate whether you need cryptographically-signed log exports or if auditor attestation of exported logs is acceptable.

We can provide the following artifacts in the first stage: KMS rotation CSV, HSM attestation, key custody diagram, policy excerpts (key management, retention), and a short list of control owners with contacts. See attached scope_proposal.pdf for details.

Please confirm and we’ll schedule the 60-minute scoping call (we’re available 2027-03-04 10:00–12:00 PT or 2027-03-05 08:00–11:00 PT).

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
(attachment: scope_proposal.pdf)

Olga / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear plan. We accept staged SFTP delivery. Couple of items before the call: 

1) Please treat Dedicated as in-scope only if Redwood-managed keys are used — that matches our resourcing plan. If any Dedicated pools are customer-managed, exclude those from the first sampling window and flag them as out-of-scope.

2) For the logs, auditor attestation on the exported CSVs is acceptable provided exports include immutable timestamps and the export process is documented; we do not require cryptographic signing for the initial sampling.

3) Please provide a one-page point of contact list for evidence delivery (name, role, email, phone) so our intake team can route uploads.

We’ll take the proposed meeting slot on 2027-03-04 at 10:00 PT. I’ve forwarded the intake_form_v2 to our intake lead and will send a calendar invite shortly.
